title: When housing is unaffordable, this artist’s device makes pedaling harder
summary: Brooklyn-based artist Justin Blinder created a device that illustrates how soaring housing costs are making life in the city that much harder. Justin Blinder had just been laid off when he first came up with the idea for Ground Truth.
